sources.title: Rapier JavaScript Advanced collision-detection
sources.license: Official documentation; redistribution license not independently verified; metadata/paraphrase only
sources.access: Actual page read with web open, including contact graph, events, manifold ordering and CCD sections
claims: Broad-phase contact-pair existence alone does not prove touching; inspect geometric/active solver contacts.
A pair may have multiple manifolds; geometric contacts and transient solver contacts have different index domains, with solved impulse retained in geometric contacts.
Collision/contact-force events require at least one collider enabling the relevant ActiveEvents; force threshold uses summed per-contact magnitudes.
Manifold1/2 refer to internal collider ordering, which can differ from query argument order.

sources.title: Rapier TempContactManifold API
sources.version: Current API site; locally cross-checked installed0.21.0 declarations
sources.access: Actual API page read; no full documentation copy stored
claims: normal is world-space; localContactPoint1/2 are collider-local geometry points.
contactImpulse uses geometric-contact index; solverContactPoint uses solver-contact index and returns world-space position or null.
Do not invent a one-to-one mapping between the two index domains.

sources.title: Rapier TempContactForceEvent API
sources.version: Current API site; locally cross-checked installed0.21.0 declarations
sources.access: Actual API page read and pinned event_queue.d.ts inspected
claims: Temporary force event may only be read inside the drain callback; copy plain data immediately.
totalForceMagnitude sums force magnitudes, unlike the magnitude of totalForce vector sum.
The force event does not expose contactImpulse; N and N*s must remain distinct.

sources.title: Rapier World contactPair API
sources.version: Current API site; locally cross-checked installed0.21.0 declarations
sources.access: Actual World API contactPair section read
claims: contactPair invokes callback for each manifold and provides a flipped boolean.
When flipped, localNormal1 and other side1 values refer to the second query collider; normalize both ordering and normal before canonical pair aggregation.
Pinned JS EventQueue collision callbacks expose two handles and started only; generic-guide Rust SENSOR/REMOVED flags are not an additional JS callback argument.

sources.title: Rapier RigidBody API and rigid-body guide
sources.version: JavaScript0.21 guide and locally installed0.21.0 declarations
sources.access: Actual guide/body API sections read; velocityAtPoint/worldCom and mode APIs checked locally
claims: linvel is COM linear velocity; angvel is angular velocity; velocityAtPoint accepts a world point; worldCom returns world COM.
Fixed, Dynamic and two Kinematic modes differ; gravityScale0 does not make a dynamic body Fixed.
Kinematic next-pose methods let the engine derive artificial velocity; direct pose setting is a teleport and should be marked discontinuity.
Post-step velocityAtPoint is a post-solve sample, not an exact pre-impact velocity; pre-step rigid-body point velocity reconstruction is a project approximation.

sources.title: Rapier sleeping guide
sources.access: Actual sleeping guide and installed isSleeping/sleep/wakeUp declarations read
claims: Sleeping dynamic bodies suspend simulation until awakened; contacts or explicit wakeUp can wake them.
OnSleep/OnWake are application state edges observed from snapshots, not native EventQueue sleep/wake callbacks.
Do not equate low speed, stopped sound state, sleeping, and Fixed body mode.

sources.title: Rapier CCD guide
sources.access: Actual CCD guide read; local maxCcdSubsteps declaration checked
claims: Fast dynamic bodies are swept against fixed targets automatically, except dynamic mesh-like shapes; per-body CCD enables moving-target sweeps.
Two CCD-enabled objects may still tunnel; this is not an unlimited collision guarantee.
maxCcdSubsteps defaults1; increasing it permits bounded successive impacts at added cost. Sound timestamps remain fixed-step unless independent substep evidence exists.

sources.title: Rapier determinism guide
claims: WASM engine determinism requires the same version, initial state, parameters, and exact add/remove order.
Nondeterministic initialization such as cross-platform transcendental JS results can invalidate equal-input assumptions.
This does not by itself prove complete behavior/asset/PRNG/audio replay determinism; record event stream, versions and seeds separately.

sources.title: Rapier colliders guide
sources.access: Actual sensor, collision groups, active collision types and active events sections read
claims: Sensors produce intersection transitions, not solid contact forces; zone events must not be impact events.
Collision detection defaults off when both bodies are non-dynamic; explicit ActiveCollisionTypes such as KINEMATIC_FIXED may be needed.
Collision groups can suppress contacts/events, while solver groups can retain contacts but suppress solved forces.
Removed collider handles may be reused; persist stable domain ID plus generation, never raw handle or body collider array index.
